prompt: Help me set up a research repository for investigating synthetic data homogenization in LLM training. I want to track research on model collapse, diversity preservation in synthetic data, and strategies to maintain model capabilities when training on generated data.

assertions.name: core_files_created
assertions.text: Core configuration files exist: README.md, CLAUDE.md, research-focus.md, classification-guide.md, .gitignore, LICENSE

assertions.name: git_initialized

assertions.name: skills_created_with_content
assertions.text: Domain-specific skills created: .claude/skills/search-papers/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/add-paper/SKILL.md exist with content

assertions.name: skills_references
assertions.text: Skills have reference files: search-papers/references/queries.md and add-paper/references/notes-template.md exist

assertions.name: research_focus_priorities

assertions.name: classification_tags
